operations.title: Nima supplies the correctly projected black-box weight-five rational trace
operations.body: Correctly typed pilot evaluator is now available at event 1283: research/nima/check_five_site_weight_five_rational_trace.py computes f_12345=(32 y1…y5)^-1 Σ_g χ(g)g*Ω directly from the 180 source terms, without expanding P_sat. On physical Kummer-cover samples it is invariant under rechoosing square roots and nonzero: 517 mod 1009, 429 mod 1013. This is the black-box base rational function needed for sampled twisted-exactness matrices; it makes no non-exactness claim.
